rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: _render_html() emitted <!DOCTYPE html><html><head>…</head>… with NO <meta charset> declaration. React-Native-WebView, when asked to render a raw HTML string via source={{html}}, defaults to Latin-1 (ISO-8859-1) if no charset is declared inside the document. The template header ('DTPS IT Operations Management · Major Incident Communication', U+00B7) and the subject default ('… – Customer Portal … – Investigating', U+2013) are stored in the seed as Python str (UTF-8 in memory); when the WebView decoded the UTF-8 byte 0xC2 0xB7 as Latin-1, byte 0xC2 became 'Â' and 0xB7 became '·', producing 'Â·'. Similarly UTF-8 bytes 0xE2 0x80 0x93 (en-dash) decoded as Latin-1 became 'â€”' ('â' + '€' + control). MITIGATION APPLIED: added <meta charset="utf-8"> and <meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8"> in _render_html(). REPRODUCTION: create any IMCR draft via POST /api/drafts, GET /api/drafts/{id}/render-html, and inspect html.encode('latin-1').decode('utf-8') vs raw — pre-fix WebView showed 'Â·' / 'â€', post-fix all Unicode code points render correctly.
